name: Pass
description: Any pass attempted from one player to another.

name: Offside Pass
description: Attempted pass made to a player in an offside position.

name: Take On
description: Attempted dribble past an opponent.

name: Foul
description: Foul committed resulting in a free kick.

name: Out
description: Ball goes out of play for a throw-in or goal kick.

name: Corner Awarded
description: Ball goes out of play for a corner kick.

name: Tackle
description: Tackle that dispossesses an opponent.

name: Interception
description: Intercepts an opposition pass and prevents it reaching its target.

name: Save
description: Goalkeeper saves a shot on goal.

name: Clearance
description: Player hits the ball clear of the defensive zone and/or out of play.

name: Miss
description: Shot on goal goes wide or over.

name: Attempt Saved
description: Shot saved; event is for the player who made the shot.

name: Goal
description: All goals.

name: Card
description: Booking/card event.

name: Player off
description: Player is substituted off.

name: Player on
description: Player comes on as a substitute.

name: Condition change
description: Change in playing conditions.

name: End
description: End of a match period.

name: Start
description: Start of a match period.

name: Team set up
description: Team lineup/setup; qualifiers contain lineup/formation information.

name: Collection End
description: Signals the end of data collection.

name: Formation change
description: Team alters its formation.

name: Punch
description: Goalkeeper punches the ball clear.

name: Deleted event
description: Event has been deleted and is resent as type 43.

name: Aerial
description: Aerial duel; outcome represents won/lost.

name: Challenge
description: Player fails to win the ball while opponent dribbles past.

name: Ball recovery
description: Team wins possession and keeps it for at least two passes or an attacking play.

name: Dispossessed
description: Player is successfully tackled and loses possession.

name: Error
description: Player mistake losing the ball; can lead to a shot/goal.

name: Keeper pick-up
description: Goalkeeper picks up the ball.

name: Offside provoked
description: Awarded to last defender when offside is given against attacker.

name: Shield ball opp
description: Defender shields ball from opponent as it rolls out.

name: Keeper Sweeper
description: Keeper comes off line/box to clear ball.

name: Ball touch
description: Bad touch/control event; outcome distinguishes result.

name: Injury Time Announcement
description: Injury time awarded by referee.

name: Blocked Pass
description: Defender close to possession blocks a pass; distinct from interception.

name: Unknown / not mapped
description: No mapping found in the public reference used for this build.

description: No mapping found in the public reference used for this build.
